name: null-members-decode-as-absent-keys
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `null` Decode (a null member yields no value; on json already 0.5) and 0.5 Residue (null members are not carried). Encode: id has no null option and is not written; label, q, s and the item's name are written null; x writes its default 7, code its sentinel "N/A"; the item's q has no null. Derived by hand.
